ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager who was a builder for years now helps in the gardens, and cannot stop measuring the bean poles.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) was a builder for years. Now (subject.he/she) is helping in the gardens, and (subject.he/she) likes it, mostly. But (subject.he/she) can't stop measuring things. Today (friend) finds (subject.him/her) checking whether the bean poles are exactly upright, with a string and a stone, and frowning at one that leans.

choices.label: Tell (subject.him/her) the Beans Like It Crooked

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) adjusts the bean pole until it's perfectly upright. The beans don't seem to care. (friend) watches, amused. "Do you miss building?" (friend.he/she) asks. (subject) thinks about it. "A bit. But beans don't fall on your foot." (subject.He/She) checks the next pole anyway.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "The beans climb better if it leans a bit," says (friend). (subject) looks horrified. "That's not how poles work." "It's how beans work." (subject) stares at the leaning pole for a long time, then, very slowly and painfully, leaves it alone. It's the hardest thing (subject.he/she) has done all week.
